subject: Invoice 2026/481 - design software licence
body: Hello, please find attached our invoice no. 2026/481 for the annual licence. Total due: €1,476.00, payable within 30 days. Best regards, TechSoft Ltd

subject: Order arrived damaged - third time this month
body: This is unacceptable. The boxes arrived crushed again and half the products are unusable. If this is not solved this week we will cancel our contract.

subject: Quote for 200 units?
body: Hi, could you send us a quote for 200 units of the standard model, with delivery to Braga before the end of November? Thanks, Marta

subject: Reminder: payment overdue
body: Dear customer, our invoice 1187 of €340.50 issued on 2 September is now 25 days overdue. Please arrange payment as soon as possible.

subject: Team lunch on Friday
body: Hi all, we're booking a table at 13:00 on Friday to celebrate the new office. Let me know if you're coming!

subject: Can we change the delivery address?
body: Hello, we moved warehouses. Could future deliveries go to Rua das Flores 12, Porto instead? Our order from yesterday hasn't shipped yet.

subject: Fatura n.º FT 2026/1032
body: Bom dia, segue em anexo a fatura referente aos serviços de outubro, no valor de 615,00 €, com vencimento a 30 de novembro. Com os melhores cumprimentos, Contabilidade Silva & Filhos

subject: Atendimento péssimo
body: Liguei três vezes esta semana e ninguém me ajudou. Continuo sem acesso à minha conta. Exijo uma solução.
note: Angry tone but no cancellation threat or 1-2 day deadline, so medium by the rubric.

subject: Pedido de informação
body: Bom dia, gostaria de saber se fazem entregas nos Açores e quais os prazos habituais. Obrigado, Rui

subject: Refund for broken kettle
body: The kettle I bought stopped working after two days. I'd like a refund or a replacement, please.
note: Complaint that also contains a request (refund).

subject: Wrong amount on invoice 2291
body: Your invoice 2291 charges us for 50 units, but we only received 40. Please send us a corrected invoice.
note: Invoice dispute: about a bill (invoice) but the customer is also unhappy (complaint).

subject: Re: delivery
body: ok thanks
note: Very short reply with no context.

subject: order
body: where is my order??? paid 2 weeks ago and nothing arrived
note: Badly written; could also be read as a customer_request for information.

subject: Our October newsletter: 5 tips for small businesses
body: In this month's edition: how to manage cash flow, the best tools for remote teams, and upcoming trade fairs in Porto. Unsubscribe at any time.

subject: Cancelamento do contrato
body: Se o problema da faturação não for resolvido até amanhã, vamos cancelar o contrato convosco.
note: Mentions billing, but the main point is a cancellation threat.

subject: Payment received - thank you
body: We confirm receipt of your payment of €1,476.00 for invoice 2026/481. No further action is required.

subject: Urgent: can we add 10 units to tomorrow's shipment?
body: Hi, our order ships tomorrow morning. Is it still possible to add 10 more units of the standard model? Please confirm today if you can.

subject: Office closed on 1 November
body: Hi team, a reminder that the office will be closed on 1 November for the public holiday. Enjoy the long weekend!

subject: You've won a €500 gift card!
body: Congratulations! Click the link below within 24 hours to claim your €500 gift card. Don't miss out!
note: Spam with fake urgency: should not be high.

subject: Aviso de pagamento em atraso
body: Exmos. Senhores, informamos que a fatura n.º 845, no valor de 1.230,00 €, se encontra vencida há 15 dias. Agradecemos a regularização com a maior brevidade.

subject: Feedback on last delivery
body: The driver was a bit rude when dropping off our order today. Just wanted to let you know, no need to reply.
note: Mild complaint that explicitly needs no action.

subject: Can you resend invoice 1187?
body: Hi, we lost the PDF of invoice 1187. Could you send it again, please?
note: A request, but about a bill, so invoice by the rubric.

subject: Solicitud de presupuesto
body: Hola, ¿podrían enviarnos un presupuesto para 50 unidades del modelo estándar? Gracias, Lucía

subject: Final warning before legal action
body: Your product leaked and damaged our warehouse floor. If we do not receive a compensation proposal within 48 hours, our lawyer will contact you.
